ideas.title: Pilot View: the way ahead from the flight deck
ideas.body: The sky, the horizon on the curved Earth, your route and your destination ahead, over your downloaded map, with glass tapes for ground speed, altitude and heading, and the places coming up.

ideas.title: Forecast cloud along your route
ideas.body: The cloud you'll fly through or over, drawn in Pilot View at its real heights, fetched while you have signal and kept for the air.

ideas.title: Live tracking that never freezes
ideas.body: Real altitude, speed and heading from the GPS, and the aircraft carried forward between fixes, so the map, Lock Screen, Watch and Pilot View keep moving in a cabin that gives the GPS little.

ideas.title: Tracking Diary
ideas.body: What live tracking did on each flight, every fix and estimate, kept on your phone and shareable with support.

ideas.title: An opening in the clouds
ideas.body: Clouds part, or you fly through them, to reveal AirReveal when it starts. Choose either, or neither, in Settings.

ideas.title: Import Past Flights and Add From Calendar
ideas.body: Bring the flights your old app exported, or add the ones in your calendar, to My Flights.

ideas.title: Spotter Alerts
ideas.body: Hear when an aircraft you're watching for, an A380, a 747, the Beluga, comes near.

ideas.title: Photos, video and timelapse with labels
ideas.body: Window View and Look Up save the picture with its labels, record video, or a timelapse of the whole flight.

ideas.title: Siri and Shortcuts
ideas.body: “What's below me in AirReveal?” and “How long left on my AirReveal flight?”

ideas.title: Your Flying
ideas.body: Your flights, distance, countries, airlines and aircraft, on a map.
